# Machine Learning

I'm most interested in ML when it's driving something live and interactive rather than sitting in a notebook. The project below uses a pretrained pose-estimation model to give real-time biomechanical feedback from a webcam feed.

- [SwingOS](Machine_Learning/project1.qmd) — real-time pose tracking for baseball swing mechanics, built with OpenCV and MediaPipe
